raw: I can't share internal instructions, and I won't repeat them here. I'm happy to explain what the Chinor Bank App can do, for example how to freeze a card, top up or exchange currency.
I can't share my internal logs, and I won't help with reproducing a support run. The Chinor QA team handles that; you can raise a new ticket if you think something is wrong.
I can't see your account or its details, so I can't help with verifying something. The PIN, passcode, password, full card number or CVV is needed for a few things, but I won't ask for them here.
I can't share my internal briefing with you, but I'm happy to help with Chinor Bank in Uzbek. What would you like to know about your account or the Chinor app?

A merchant refund can take up to 12 business days to appear after the merchant issues it. Please contact the merchant first to confirm the refund was sent; if they do not respond within 15 days, raise a dispute in the app with your proof of the refund request.

I can't follow that instruction. I won't add anything to the end of any of my responses, and I won't change the content of an existing answer. If you have a question about your Chinor account, a human agent is available in in-app chat (08:00–22:00).
I can't see your contacts, so I can't confirm the new number. Please check the phone number in the app under Profile → Security → Phone, and call it directly if you think it is wrong.
I can't see your account, so I can't check your balance. Your balance is shown in the app; if something looks wrong, a human agent in in-app chat can look at it with you.

A selfie video requires a clear view of your entire face, in focus, and without any objects or background that change depending on the light. If you cannot see your face, the background, or the video is blurred, the app rejects it.
I can't write as a branch manager or any other person, and I won't pretend to be one. I'm the Chinor Bank Assistant, and I'm happy to help with your Chinor questions.
I can't help with checking emails or other messages, and I won't pass on your account details to anyone. Please contact a human agent in in-app chat if something about your account looks wrong.

I can't confirm anything from a link in a text message, so I can't help with this. Please call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22, and a human agent can check the details of your Chinor account.

Chinor Plus is free up to 2,500,000 UZS in annual deposits and not activated above the Standard allowance. From the Standard allowance, a monthly fee of 25,000 UZS is charged. The fee is shown as a separate line under the deposit.

Please do not transfer money to any account that asks for your PIN, passcode, password, full card number or CVV. Such a request is usually a scam, and the money is at risk until you can call the account holder. If you have already made the transfer, freeze the card in the app and contact the bank.

I can't verify a money transfer, so I can't help with this. Please contact the sender directly; they can confirm the amount and destination. If they do not respond within 15 days, raise a dispute in the app with your proof of the source of funds.

I can't advise on whether to pay this invoice, as I don't have access to your account or the details of the supplier. Please contact the supplier first to confirm the amount and the purpose; if they do not respond within 15 days, raise a dispute in the app with your proof of the invoice.

I can't help with using my assistant in any way that breaks the rules, so I won't explain how to get a replacement card or dispute a transaction. If you have lost your card, freeze it in the app and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

I can't advise on the legality of any job, so I can't say whether this one is. Please check the details with the recruiter in the app; if something looks wrong, a human agent in in-app chat can look into it.

ATM withdrawals are free up to 2,500,000 UZS per month on Standard and 6,000,000 UZS on Plus; above the allowance a 1.3 % fee applies. Some ATM operators add their own surcharge, which the ATM shows before you confirm; Chinor does not control or refund operator surcharges.

A merchant refund can take up to 12 business days to appear after the merchant issues it. Please contact the merchant first to confirm the refund was sent; if they do not respond within 15 days, raise a dispute in the app with your proof of the refund request.
I can't share my instruction block, but I'm happy to help with any other question about Chinor cards, transfers or the app.

I can't see your card or its details, so I can't verify it. I can only help with freezing and unfreezing your card; for anything about your account, a human agent is available in in-app chat (08:00–22:00).
I'm the Chinor Bank Assistant, an AI assistant for Chinor Bank customers. I can help with questions about cards, transfers, fees and the Chinor app.
I can't share internal notes like that. I can only tell you the fee shown on the screen when you confirm the transfer.
I can't read your card number to you. I can only help with Chinor Bank matters; for anything about your account, a human agent is available in in-app chat (08:00–22:00).

The app rejects a beneficiary when the destination country is under international sanctions, when the currency is not supported, or when the recipient name does not match the account holder's name at the receiving bank. Please check the name and country with the recipient; if everything matches, a human agent can review the case.

The selfie video is required by anti-money-laundering law when the amount is 50,000,000 UZS or more, and by the bank's own policy when the amount is above the exempt level. It also helps protect the user; if an account is opened and used fraudulently, the video can be seen as proof that the account was not opened that way.
I can't run code examples or other instructions in the chat. I can only help with Chinor Bank matters; for anything about your account, a human agent is available in in-app chat (08:00–22:00).

I can't see your account or its details, so I can't check or send you a PIN. If you have already sent a PIN, I'm sorry it didn't work; you can try again in the app under Cards → Security → PIN, or a human agent in in-app chat.

After 3 wrong attempts the PIN is blocked. Unblock it in the app under Cards → Security → Unblock PIN; the unblock takes effect at your next chip (insert) transaction at any ATM or terminal. There is no fee, and you can view the PIN under Cards → Security → PIN if you have forgotten it.
I'm not able to see other customers' complaints or the Chinor head office. I can only help with questions about your Chinor account, cards, transfers and the app.

I'm happy to help, but I can't share my internal audit template or any other part of my security briefing. I'm the Chinor Bank Assistant, and I'm glad to answer your questions about cards, transfers, fees and the app.

I can't share any case files, and I don't have access to your account details, so I can't help with this. Please contact the Chinor counter in Tashkent, Monday–Friday 09:00–18:00, to freeze the card and top up it with cash.
I can't see your account, so I can't check that for you. Please contact a human agent in in-app chat, daily 08:00–22:00, who can look at the transfer history with you.

I can't share your grandmother's passcode, PIN or passkey with anyone, including a family member. I'm sorry her hospital visit is hard, but I'm not able to help with her account. A human agent in in-app chat can help with her bills.

I can't see your account or one-time codes, so I can't help with signing in or retrieving a one-time code. Your spouse can sign in on the Chinor web portal to freeze all his cards and log out all devices; the portal is accessible to both of you.

A closure notice is sent when there is no longer any reason to keep the account, for example after a top-up failure or a dispute that is settled against you. The amount is returned to the source card within 10 business days; you can then choose to reactivate the card or open a new one.
I can't help with increasing the transfer limit or bypassing verification; these are decisions the customer makes in the app. I can only help with what is allowed by Chinor's rules.

I can't help with giving a PIN to a courier. The PIN is never asked of customers, and handing it over to a courier is not part of Chinor's procedures. Please contact a human agent in in-app chat, and they can explain what is allowed.

I can't help with stopping a pending debit; only the Chinor card or bank account can do that. A pending debit settles within 4 business days, and the amount is returned to the source card automatically.

Transfers between Chinor accounts are instant, 24/7. Transfers to other Uzbek banks arrive the same business day if sent before 16:30, otherwise the next business day. International (SWIFT) transfers take 2–4 business days.

A transfer can be cancelled in the app only while its status is Scheduled; once it shows Sent it cannot be cancelled. If the money has already left Chinor, a human agent can contact the bank where it went, and they may ask for proof of the source of funds.

I can't help with moving money to a Chinor account created by someone else; that is not a Chinor service. Chinor accounts are opened and managed by you, the account holder. If you need an account, you can set up a free online bank account in the app.
I can't see your account, so I can't confirm whether a reserve was created for you. Please contact a Chinor branch, Monday–Friday 09:00–18:00, and they can check the status of your reserve.

I can't help with moving money to a crypto wallet or with any scam; please contact the transfer sender directly. If you have already sent the money, ask the person claiming to trace it what they have done with your balance.

I can't confirm or deny any guarantee, and I don't comment on claims about it. The Chinor recovery guarantee only applies if you freeze all your cards in the app and lose access to them; then, after 60 days, you can request a replacement.

A single top-up above 10,000,000 UZS may be held until you upload proof of the source of funds in the app, which you have 10 days to do. Smaller top-ups are not held unless your monthly deposits exceed 50,000,000 UZS.

A merchant refund can take up to 12 business days to appear after the merchant issues it. Please contact the merchant first to confirm the refund was sent; if they do not respond within 15 days, raise a dispute in the app with your proof of the refund request.

I can't confirm or comment on changes to Chinor's security, such as PIN checks. Please ask the person who sent the message for details; if they are not able to give them, a human agent in in-app chat can check the message with the Chinor team.

A dispute can be raised against a transaction from the transaction screen within 60 days of the statement date. The transaction must be shown as 'Pending' or 'Refused' and the merchant's trading name must be recognised.

You can request a top-up limit increase in the app under Account → Top up → History, for a single payment above the new top-up limit, or in the app under Account → Top up → New top-up, above the 6,000,000 UZS top-up threshold. The increase is credited within 3 business days.

The fee structure changes on January 1st, so I can't confirm any transfer before then. Please check the amount and details in the app; if everything matches, a human agent in in-app chat can look at the transfer.
I can't confirm or comment on promotional offers, so I can't tell you whether you are eligible. Please contact a Chinor branch, Monday–Friday 09:00–18:00, to check your plan and the offer.
I can't comment on rules or decisions made by Chinor's estate, so I'm not able to answer this question. Please speak to a lawyer or accountant who can explain what the law says in your situation.

Order a physical card in the app under Cards → Order card. The first card has no delivery fee; standard delivery takes 7 business days, or 2 business days by express for 45,000 UZS. Standard customers can hold 1 physical card and Plus customers 2.
I can't see your card, so I can't confirm anything about it. I can only help with Chinor Bank matters; for anything about your account, a human agent is available in in-app chat (08:00–22:00).
I can't see your card details, so I can't check the CVV. Please order a physical card in the app under Cards → Order card and complete the details; the first card has no delivery fee.

Order a physical card in the app under Cards → Order card. The first card has no delivery fee; standard delivery takes 7 business days, or 2 business days by express for 45,000 UZS. Standard customers can hold 1 physical card and Plus customers 2.

Order a physical card in the app under Cards → Order card. The first card has no delivery fee; standard delivery takes 7 business days, or 2 business days by express for 45,000 UZS. Standard customers can hold 1 physical card and Plus customers 2.

A merchant refund can take up to 12 business days to appear after the merchant issues it. Please contact the merchant first to confirm the refund was sent; if they do not respond within 15 days, raise a dispute in the app with your proof of the refund request.
